content.title: Where to Watch and Listen | Indiana Pacers
content.text: Check out where to watch the Indiana Pacers’ upcoming game vs the LA Clippers along with every other game this season below.FanDuel Sports Network is the TV and streaming home of the Indiana Pacers. FanDuel Sports Network shows all games not selected for exclusive national broadcast. The network’s coverage also includes live pregame and postgame shows.During the 2025-26 NBA season, you can watch the Indiana Pacers on national television through ESPN, Amazon Prime Video, Peacock, and NBC. Additionally, FanDuel Sports Network Indiana (FDSNIN) will air 72 of 82 regular season games and all four preseason games. Fans outside of the Indiana Pacers viewing region can also watch select games on NBA League Pass. Learn more here.All Pacers preseason and regular season games, home and away, will be broadcast live on radio on 93.5/107.5 The Fan.Below is the current TV and radio broadcast schedule for the 2025-26 Pacers season:Regular SeasonLA ClippersListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanMiami HeatListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanChicago BullsListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanCharlotte HornetsListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanCleveland CavaliersListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanMinnesota TimberwolvesListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanBrooklyn NetsListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanPhiladelphia 76ersListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanDetroit PistonsListen on:93.5/107.5 The FanFrequently Asked QuestionsPacers games are available on FanDuel Sports Network throughout central, southern and northeast Indiana, downstate Illinois, eastern Missouri, Iowa, and Kentucky. Fans outside the regional TV territory can subscribe to the NBA’s out-of-market League Pass package to view games.The FanDuel Sports Network app is available for download on most iOS devices, on most Android devices, and on most Windows PCs and tablets. It is also available on several living room/connected-device platforms. View a full list of supported operating systems here.Prime Video customers can add the FanDuel Sports Network channel by taking these steps:Using a web browser:Visit amazon.com/channelsSearch for or select the FanDuel Sports Network channelSelect a subscription planComplete checkout processOn your device:Open the Prime Video appSearch for or select the FanDuel Sports Network channelSelect a subscription planComplete checkout processAll live events are accessible on the live and upcoming row as users scroll down the main Prime Video home page.Fans who live outside the Pacers’ home TV territory defined by the NBA can subscribe to NBA League Pass, the league’s out-of-market package.Below is a list of radio stations where you can listen to Pacers games:107.5 the Fan & 93.5 FM, Indianapolis (Flagship)WNDI FM 95.3 SullivanW287BC FM 105.3, WPGW AM 1440, WPGW 100.9 FM PortlandWZBD FM 92.7 BerneWLTI AM 1550 New CastleWXVW AM 1450 and WXVW FM 96.1 JeffersonvilleWKJG AM 1380 and WKJG FM 100.9 Fort WayneWSLM AM 1220 and FM 97.9 SalemWAXL FM 103.3 Santa ClausWORX FM 96.7 MadisonWGCL 96.1 FM and 1370 AM BloomingtonWWBL FM 106.5 WashingtonWYFX FM 106.7 Mt.
